EmailTemplate.subject: A Message from REI Nation!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Lead.Name},
Since you found our company, whether you recently downloaded one our e-books from Bigger Pockets, found us on Google, or perhaps you heard about us from a friend or colleague, I wanted to touch base with you to see if you would like to {!User.Time_Trade_Link__c} to discuss your investment strategy. The purpose of the call would be to determine if we would be a good fit for you as an investment company. I hope to speak with you soon!
Here are a few bullet points about REI Nation (formerly Memphis Invest):
Family owned turnkey company with 15+ years of experience assisting out-of-area real estate investors to build their passive income portfolios We own our own property management company, where we manage over 6,000 properties exclusively for the 2000+ investor clients that have purchased properties from REI Nation/Memphis Invest We offer positive cash-flow, fully rehabbed properties in Memphis, Dallas, Houston, Little Rock, St. Louis, Tulsa, Oklahoma City and San Antonio We do not publish our properties on our website. You will need to speak with a portfolio adviser, who will help you determine whether we are a good fit to work together as a company and a potential investor/client Our average properties are priced between $120-220k depending on the market Our average tenant resident stays over 4.5 years. Our average maintenance per property is less than 4% of gross rents annually, and our average vacancy per property is less than 2% annually Over 1/3 of our clients have 4 properties or more with us, and over 50% of new clients come in as referrals from existing clients We have every piece of infrastructure in place that an investor could ever need in order to invest, including our network of approved lenders (Fannie Mae conventional financing, non-conventional financing, and non-recourse financing for retirement accounts such as solo-401ks and self-directed IRAs), a discounted group policy property insurance, closing attorneys, title companies, fully vetted 1031 exchange process, and IRA custodian companies that can help position your retirement accounts so that you can invest in real estate
In addition, many of our Investors are active on our private Facebook group: REI Nation - Profiting from Passive Real Estate Group. The group is a closed group with no solicitations, but regular posts with videos about our Property Management performance level, advice from the owners on timely real estate topics and interviews with our investors on their customer journey and experience. We would love for you to join us - - - You are personally invited to the REI Nation - Profiting from Passive Real Estate Group.
If you have not already checked out our site, please visit https://www.reination.com/company/about-us when you get a chance today and you can learn more about us. Particularly, I encourage you to watch the client videos. Our clients will all tell you some version of the same message- that we are not perfect, but we take great care of them.
So now that you know a little more about us, let's schedule a call if you feel like this is possibly the right path for you. {!User.Time_Trade_Link__c} to schedule a call with me this week at a time that works well for you.
Looking forward to connecting with you soon!
Best,
